title: FoodieQA: A Multimodal Dataset for Fine-Grained Understanding of Chinese Food Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) on multiple-choice question-answering tasks (multi-image, single-image, and text-only) based on a manually curated dataset of 14 regional Chinese cuisines to measure fine-grained cultural awareness and regional knowledge gaps.

Comparing the performance of bilingual and multilingual models on Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks using both Chinese and translated English prompts to observe performance disparities based on the query language.
